role: support-only cross-input-resolution residual control; no test image or test label

historical_audit.resolution_storage_finding: full448/full896 were evaluated as independent NN arms and INT8 roundtrip; no high-low feature residual
historical_audit.scale_fusion_finding: fixed full896/low bilinear/concat/late arms; no direct cross-resolution residual or low-to-high predictor
historical_audit.full896_extension_finding: dual-resolution clean/synthetic cache export only; no residual arm
historical_audit.related_prior_art_finding: HLGFA (2026, v3) already describes frozen-backbone high-low resolution consistency, structure/detail decomposition, and gated residual
historical_audit.novelty_boundary: the residual concept is not original; this probe only measures a few-shot normal-only closed-form residual and support-only cost/quality control
historical_audit.audit_conclusion: direct cross-input-resolution residual route is not a completed historical experiment; this run is a bounded control, not a novelty claim

cache_index.index_rule: match manifest ref_rel; high full896 kind-major thin_scratch/cutpaste; low v14 kind-major cutpaste/local_erasure/thin_scratch
cache_index.mask_rule: high full896 synthetic mask must equal the corresponding low v14 mask byte-for-byte

fixed_arms.high_only64: high feature row-L2 then global L2 NN
fixed_arms.low_only64: low feature bilinear-to-64, row-L2 then global L2 NN
fixed_arms.late_mean64: arithmetic mean of high-only and low-only 64-grid distance maps, then common map post-processing
fixed_arms.direct_residual64: row-L2 high minus row-L2 low; score is residual row L2 norm
fixed_arms.high_residual_concat64: row-L2 high and row-L2 direct residual, each multiplied by 1/sqrt(2), concat, row-L2, global L2 NN
fixed_arms.ridge_residual64: fit low-to-high ridge on the other clean support image only; query score is row L2 of own high minus predicted high
fixed_arms.wrong_pair_residual64: synthetic-only control: current query high minus same-query next-seed low, row-L2 residual norm

fixed_parameters.concat_equal_weight: 1/sqrt(2) per normalized high/residual branch; no weight scan
fixed_parameters.ridge_fit: fit_intercept=False; X=other-support row-L2 low; Y=other-support row-L2 high; normal memory only
fixed_parameters.wrong_pair_rule: same query support image, same family, seed (s + 1) mod 3; fixed before AP
fixed_parameters.nearest_neighbor: global over all 4096 memory cells; Euclidean distance of row-L2 descriptors via sqrt(2 - 2 max cosine)
fixed_parameters.score_map_postprocess: src.utils.dists2map: cv2 INTER_LINEAR resize to 1024 x 1024 followed by Gaussian sigma=4

data_roles.memory: only the other clean support image in the same category for NN and ridge fitting; query image cells excluded
data_roles.synthetic_query: main arms use the query's own high and low cached variant; no clean counterpart oracle
data_roles.normal_control: own clean query score distribution; not FPR
data_roles.wrong_pair_exception: explicit synthetic control only; low branch comes from the same query support image's fixed next-seed variant

evaluation.normal: mean / p95 / p99 score distribution for clean query after common map post-processing; no clean-vs-nuisance FPR
evaluation.novelty_boundary: cross-resolution residual and ridge are bounded controls; no algorithm novelty claim
